items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Pres wanted a drummer and I had a very good drummer up there... Pres did keep him, kept him there for his run at Birdland

ctx.x: Oh great, great. See, we made some of those first recordings with Billie, "Miss Brown to You," and "What Living Moonlight Can Do," with Korby, Ben, I think it was Benny Goodman and Billy Taylor, Teddy Wilson, Artie Shaw on on some of them, wasn't he? I just forget now. But we all made those first recordings.
Yeah, yeah, yeah, made some with Lester.
